email.subject1: a signal play for HR Acuity
email.body1:
Jess, saw HR Acuity joined the Workday Innovation Partner Program with the bi-directional case-management sync into Workday Help.

A partnership that big usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps can work them, and that is exactly where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HR Acuity off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jess, quick follow-up for HR Acuity.

Riding a Workday partnership, the number usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the new target, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HR Acuity needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jess, last bit of proof for HR Acuity.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HR Acuity's reply rate likely compares to peer HR-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jess, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new Workday motion takes real focus, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to HR Acuity either way.
